svg.text: deployment RE-LOOP | Production on a single-node Kubernetes VM
{namespace = reloop-production; one server node runs control plane and workloads}
No Ingress / PVC in this profile
K3s server runs on this VM.
UML notation follows the supplied slides: instance-level nodes (pp. 8-9), nested nodes (p. 12), artifacts (p. 14), deployment specification (p. 16), communication paths (p. 17).
Underlined name : Type = node instance; nested artifact = deployed file/directory; solid line = communication path (not a data-flow arrow).
Pod names ending in -* identify generated workload instances; actual Pod suffixes were not queried. K3s/Pod/Container are modeled as execution environments.
Runtime topology: deploy/production-cloud/k8s-production.py + README.md; gateway routing and Dockerfiles checked. This is a configuration view, not live-cluster verification.
Primary gateway / database paths are shown; secondary internal notification calls and external SMTP are omitted. Cloudflare / origin proxy retained from original; live TLS configuration unverified.
Production has seven application workloads and three data workloads. Reviews are handled by product-service; no separate review-service is deployed by this profile.
